meta.title: Rai Language Center | Learn. Connect. Succeed. Since 1995
meta.description: Rai Language Center in Latakia — kids & teens programs, adult courses, TOEFL & IELTS prep, Business English, and a free placement test. Since 1995.

hero.headline: Learn. Connect.
hero.lede: Thirty years of building confidence and opening doors. Join the thousands who chose Rai to master a language.

story.title: Three decades of excellence in language education.
story.p1: Our journey began in 1995 with a simple ambition: that every learner in Latakia could master a language with confidence, in a way that respected their intelligence and their time.
story.p2: Today, thousands of graduates later, we still believe the best education starts with a real human relationship between teacher and student — nourished by a modern curriculum, and crowned by results.

courses.title: Four paths. One goal: language mastery.

items.title: Kids & Teens
items.summary: Programs designed to build fluency through fun and interaction.
items.details: We use educational games, stories, and group activities to build a strong language foundation and lasting love of learning. Small groups, similar age cohorts.

items.title: Adult Conversation
items.summary: From zero to fluent — a practical curriculum that puts conversation first.
items.details: We integrate all four skills with a special focus on real-world conversation: everyday situations, debates, and presentations. Morning and evening groups.

items.title: TOEFL & IELTS Prep
items.summary: Intensive training and weekly reviews with full mock exams.
items.details: We cover all four sections with specialized strategies. Detailed performance analysis and training to manage time and pressure on exam day.

items.title: Business English
items.summary: Professional workplace language: correspondence, presentations, negotiation, and meetings.
items.details: Content designed for the demands of modern work: writing emails and reports, presenting, and the vocabulary of your industry. Private or group sessions.

items.title: Experienced instructors
items.body: A handpicked team with strong academic backgrounds and real teaching experience.

items.title: Modern, interactive curriculum
items.body: Continuously updated materials that blend the book, live practice, and technology.

items.title: Supportive environment
items.body: A safe space to learn — make mistakes with confidence, grow faster than expected.

items.title: Documented results
items.body: Thousands of graduates, hundreds of success stories, and distinguished international exam scores.

wins.title: Wall of wins.
wins.lede: Real graduates. Real certificates. Dreams turned into reality.
